message.title: PitLog v1.5.20 Released 🚀
message.body:
A focused update with fixes and improvements across the board:

- Account Hide / Unhide — hidden accounts now correctly disappear from Trade Log, Prop Firm Tracker, and all views
- Prop Firm: MLL buffer bar now shows visually how much buffer remains after a withdrawal
- Prop Firm: MLL floor correctly fixed at starting balance after withdrawals
- Prop Firm: Payout Rules now shows total amount extracted across all withdrawals
- Manual trades: editing price, quantity or side now correctly recalculates P&L
- Cycle filter: trades made on the same day as a withdrawal are now included correctly
- Backup: export now saves as .zip (database + screenshots), restore shows a clear restart prompt
- Setup wizard: new Skip button for experienced users

📧 Use the download link from your original Payhip purchase email to get the latest version.
